_comment: Post-game and the two systems that replace it: Descend Again for replay and Merge Causality for carrying trained versions of a unit forward. There is no post-game campaign and no traditional New Game Plus, which is the headline.

_mechanics.postgame: There is no separate post-game campaign. Finishing the story returns you to the moment before the final battle and leaves the whole game open to replay.
_mechanics.newGamePlus: There is no traditional New Game Plus either. The replay route is Descend Again on the title screen, which restarts at a higher difficulty and replays the prologue.
_mechanics.carryOver: Once at least one Part I route is complete, these carry into a replay: map exploration, unlocked classes, Boons of Salvation, and sidequest progress.
_mechanics.merge: Merge Causality sits at the Shrine of Causality and combines multiple Part 1 versions of the same unit, trained on different lords~ routes, into a single flexible Part 3 unit.
_mechanics.mergeRules: All Abilities and Combat Arts from the merged versions are inherited, and the higher stat wins wherever the versions disagree. The payoff is a Part 3 unit with a wider choice of classes, abilities and Combat Arts.
_mechanics.mergeTiming: Karma Shards feed two systems and Merge Causality is the second one, available from Part III and used on characters you have already recruited.

_openGaps: No post-game-exclusive content: the sources agree that nothing is locked behind finishing the story.
No merge costs or limits: how many shards a merge takes, how many times it can be done and whether it can be undone are all unrecorded.
No support inheritance: whether supports carry through a merge is not recorded either way.
No Descend Again detail beyond difficulty and the replayed prologue, and that row is itself marked unverified.
